column2: Hmmm... I can't make sense of it...!
Solving mysteries is a scientist's duty, I tell you! Leave it to me!
Hmmm... hmmm...
The moon and the sun... There's a lot of room for thought there, I'd say...
Everyone's pretty badly shaken. After all, someone who was their friend turned into a monster.
I've had enough of somebody controlling my body... And getting hurt by a friend I trusted is even worse...!
I'm used to doin' the betrayin', but not to bein' betrayed. Who do I mean? {s}, that's who!
I get how you feel about {s}, {p}. But that thing's not {s} anymore! It's a monster!
Maybe inviting {s} to Hell Villa was a mistake to begin with.
It hurts, it hurts... My head hurts somethin' awful...
I've got chills... I've never felt like this before...
To think that even I was bested! Next time, I'll finish it for sure! You should forget about {s}, my boy!
Bah, a scratch like this! You hit me, I hit back! Even if it's the former {s}!
Owww! Boss, I can't take this anymore...
I feel bad for you, {p}, but you should forget about {s} now...
I'm Jiro Shutendo, and I'm also the Shutendoji. Even so, I'm still me. But {s} has become a monster!
Against such a monster, how long can I protect Doji...
In that fight, for the first time I felt fear. That one is terrifying!
I'm scared... of the black fiends...! Of {s}...!
A friend we fought side by side with betrayed us. It's hard...
Unforgivable! Pullin' one over on the Boss!
Ouchie... it hurts... it hurts...
Dammit! It hurts! Somebody do somethin'!
I'm sorry... No matter how hard I try to believe in {s}, I can't forget that terrifying form!
Honestly, I was scared. Even now... I'm scared...
I've always bent others to my will, but this is the first time I've been controlled by someone else... What a lousy feeling!
Sh-shake, shiver... S-so scary...!
Everyone liked {s}... That's why they're so shocked. Better not let it get to you...
She looked nothing like {s}... Even I get scared remembering it...
They can't forget the terror of being controlled by the black fiends... They might have ended up like {s} themselves.
I think they'll understand someday.\n\nUntil then, better not let what they say get to you...
Controlling bodies, turning friends into traitors, hurting them... I won't forgive the Demon King!
Things got ugly. But don't give up! Whatever it is, you give up and it's over!
Cheer up, {p}!\n\n{s}'ll come back to normal for sure!
The Demon King's existence troubles me...
Never thought it'd come to this... I'm itching to take down the Demon King!
I know just how you feel, I do!
I don't believe it!\n\nThat {s} turned into a monster!
Controlling people at will with black things... Who is this Demon King!?
That Demon King sure pulls some nasty stuff, huh!
I'm mad, I really am!
You're worried about {s}, right? Me too. But we'll rescue her for sure! So cheer up!
Not knowing what you are is really hard. I bet {s} is suffering terribly too.
It is not yet certain that {s} has become a monster completely!
Even against {s}, I must fight. That is my fate!
What's going to happen to the world now...
Aphrodite A will beat the Demon King! Leave it to me!
I ain't scared of nothin'! Not even the Demon King!
I hate gettin' controlled, so we gotta beat the Demon King!
Bring it on, anytime ya like!
Cheer up, {p}! Believe in my fists!
I know how you feel, {p}, my boy. You must be worried sick, eh? Well, this old man's gonna give it everything he's got!
Seems we got caught up in a terrrifying case...
Demon Kiiing, Demon Kiiing, beat him uuup!
Everyone knows the black things can control people. So why is {s} the one being called a monster?
Because {s} is the "Moon of destruction," maybe? But what is the "Moon of destruction"...
Too many mysteries...
The Demon King called you the "Sun of rebirth," right? What does "Sun of rebirth" mean?
When they called me Susano-oh, I felt really uneasy. I know how you feel right now, {p}.
Thanks, Shusha-kun.
The Moon of destruction... the Sun of rebirth... the time of joining... Hmmm...
Nothing but mysteries... I'm getting tired, I tell you...
Every time I try to solve a mystery, a new one appears...
Mumble mumble... Huh!? Oh no, I dozed off...
In my opinion...! Huh, what was I going to say?
No, don't leave the residential area!
They're after you, you know!
What do we do... He's gone!
I'll go tell Professor Yumi!
...Honestly! That boy!!
Thank goodness! You're okay! Leaving Honey behind like that... how cold!
Thank goodness! Looks like you're okay! The meeting just ended. Professor Yumi wants to see you!
If these people find me, I'm dead... Let's go somewhere else...
{p}-kun! Thank goodness, looks like you're okay. The meeting just ended. Professor Yumi wants to see you.
{p}-kun! Thank goodness, looks like you're okay. The meeting just ended.\n\nDr. Saotome wants to see you.
There might still be more friends who'll lend us their strength. Somewhere out there...
Many of the people controlled by the black fiends passed out and were taken to the hospital.
{p}-kun! I've finally found the answer! The Demon King is waiting for a solar eclipse!
You mean an eclipse, when the moon blocks the sun's light?
Exactly!\n\nMost likely, the Demon King will gain his true power when the eclipse comes.
Every time the Dimension Chain has occurred, a certain thing has appeared. The black moon!\n\n...So when an eclipse happens, what appears?
Huh? ...Uh, um... Oh!
That's right, a black sun!\n\nWhen the black sun appears, the Demon King will gain his true power!
So when's the next eclipse?
Tomorrow...
Tomorrow!?
We must make a plan at once!\n\nCome to the salon! It's a strategy meeting!
The Moon of destruction, the Sun of rebirth... and the time of joining that's soon to come! The eclipse is the conclusion drawn from those keywords, I tell you.
The sun's light brings blessings to people. At the moment the moon blocks it, the Demon King will destroy the world!
The Demon King has used the black moon to join the worlds together. What is he scheming to do with a black sun...?
The question is what the Sun of rebirth means, you see. That's the one thing we still don't quite understand.
...So there you have it, everyone! The eclipse is tomorrow! If my reasoning is correct, tomorrow the Demon King gains his true power!
And {p}-kun! There's something I forgot to tell you. In all likelihood, {s}-kun is alive and well!
The proof is that you're alive. After all, the Demon King called {s}-kun the "moon" and you the "sun."
I see... If the Demon King needs me... then there's a good chance {s} is still alive too!
The Demon King is keeping watch over {s}-kun so she can't escape.\n\nAnd he's probably controlling people to try to get his hands on you.
